description: Weekly dependency update pull requests. docs/testing.md#dependency-updates explains these settings.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the 14-day wait, as AGENTS.md allows.

packageRules.description: Gradle updates, the version catalog and the wrapper included, use the build type.
GitHub Actions and runner updates use the ci type.
Kotlin's plugins and kotlin-test share one catalog version, and the Compose compiler ships with Kotlin. KSP runs on Kotlin's compiler, so it is tested with them.
prBodyNotes: A new Kotlin minor version may also need a newer Hilt. See docs/architecture.md#build-settings.

packageRules.description: Each compose-rules release is built for one detekt version, so both change in one pull request, and only after the maintainer approves it on the Dependency Dashboard.
prBodyNotes: Check compose-rules' supported versions table for this detekt version, and read detekt's release notes. See docs/architecture.md#formatting-and-lint.

packageRules.description: The build needs JDK 17, as AGENTS.md says, so the JDK version in the workflows' setup-java steps changes only by hand.

AGP sets the default build tools version, which the pull request and emulator tests workflows install. build-logic derives the version of lint's libraries, which :lint-rules compiles against, from AGP's.
prBodyNotes: If the build fails on a missing build-tools package, update the SDK steps in .github/workflows/pull-request.yml and .github/workflows/emulator-tests.yml and the Commands section of AGENTS.md on this branch.

lint-api and lint-tests follow AGP, at AGP's version plus 23. Check that :lint-rules' Kotlin apiVersion in build-logic is still no newer than the kotlin-stdlib that the new lint-api POM names. See docs/testing.md#dependency-updates.

packageRules.description: Spotless downloads ktfmt, and ktfmt 0.65 and later need Spotless 8.10.4 or later to load their org.jetbrains.kotlinx coordinates, so both change in one pull request. A ktfmt update can change the formatting.
prBodyNotes: If spotlessCheck fails, run ./gradlew spotlessApply on this branch and push the result.

packageRules.description: Renovate writes the new checksum before it runs the wrapper task, so the checksum changes even when the task fails.
prBodyNotes: If gradle-wrapper.jar, gradlew and gradlew.bat didn't change, run ./gradlew wrapper on this branch and push any changes it makes.

packageRules.description: JitPack lists many NewPipeExtractor versions both with and without their v. Gradle versioning ranks any version that starts with a number above one that starts with a letter, so Renovate offered 0.26.5 over v0.27.1 (#189). Only v-tagged versions with two or more numbers count, such as v0.9 or v0.27.1. The catalog uses that form.

customManagers.description: ktfmt has no library entry in the catalog, because Spotless downloads it. From 0.65 on, ktfmt is published as org.jetbrains.kotlinx:ktfmt instead of com.facebook:ktfmt.
Gummy Bears has no library entry, because build-logic builds the artifact name from minSdk. Change api-29 here when minSdk changes.
